M1: option 1 (collision theory) difference in activation energy / ionisation energy OR option 2 (atomic structure) ionisation energies are different

M2: option 1 affects the frequency of effective collisions (between particles / molecules) OR affects the proportion of particles with energy greater than activation energy OR option 2 a decrease in nuclear attraction due to EITHER increase in shielding OR increase in distance of outer electron from nucleus OR increase in number of shells of electrons
